item.title: Lubavitcher Yeshiva Begins Major Expansion Ahead of Tes Adar
item.description: Hashgacha Protis: Tomchei Temimim in Crown Heights has officially begun on the next phase of its building expansion, just in time for Tes Adar - the day the Frierdiker Rebbe arrived on the shores of America and declared that “America is nisht andersh.” Full Story

item.title: Community Purim Bash With Eli Marcus
item.description: A festive Purim party will take place in Crown Heights, with l’chaims, music and dancing and lavish Dairy Buffet at Bais Rivkah on Lefferts Avenue. Full Story

item.title: Singer’s New Dance Track Composed By Cousin
item.description: Chabad singer Shmuly Hurwitz has released the new pumping dance track “Uri Uri” composed by his cousin, Boruch Sholom Blesofsky. Video

item.title: Picture of the Day
item.description: Attention Mayor Mamdani: The corner of Union and Kingston Streets in Crown Heights, overwhelmed with trash, is being called "Mount Trashmore" by bochurim learning nearby. The snow-covered street is too narrow for garbage trucks to pass through. Photos

item.title: Rabbi Chanina Sperlin Appointed Chaplain for Port Authority Police
item.description: Rabbi Chanina Sperlin has been appointed as a chaplain for the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey Police Department (PAPD), providing both spiritual and non-spiritual support to department members and their families. Full Story

item.title: Stranded CTeen Chapters Thank NYPD After Summit Weekend
item.description: Jewish teens stranded in New York following the winter storm visited NYPD precincts around Crown Heights today to personally thank the officers who provided security throughout the CTeen International Summit. Full Story

item.title: Video: How Chabad Became Ukraine’s Emergency Lifeline
item.description: When Russia attacked, the decades-old Chabad network instantly flipped from religious outreach to a massive rescue and relief operation, saving tens of thousands. Watch their story. Full Story, Video
